body:
- **Core (v1):** sort, per-column filter, global search, column
  resize + double-click-to-fit (canvas-measured), column visibility,
  row virtualization, sticky header, StorageAdapter persistence,
  JSON/MD export of filtered view.
- **v1.1 quick wins:** multi-column sort (shift-click), match
  highlight, density toggle, aggregation footer, row selection + bulk
  copy to clipboard, keyboard nav, pinned columns.
- **v1.2 structural:** row grouping with per-group aggregations,
  typed filter UIs (numeric range / date range / multi-select / bool
  tri-state), row expansion detail panel, URL-sync for shareable
  views.
- **v2 rich types:** `sparkline`, `icon`, `country`, `duration`,
  `range`, `code-block`, `json`, `image`.
- **UX polish:** minimal-icon toolbar with hover reveal, full-screen
  toggle, raw-source toggle (shows authored fence in monospace),
  author-specified column widths, canvas text measurement, persisted
  state versioning (`_v: 2`) so cached narrow widths don't override
  new auto-sizes.
